## LaTeX that renders

Rendered with KaTeX 0.16.21 -- the version the app loads -- and
`throwOnError: true`. The app itself renders with `throwOnError: false`,
so in production these failures are silent.

| backend | strings checked | render | fail |
|---|---|---|---|
| `macos-vision + apple-on-device` | 9 | 100% (9) | 0 |

## What the notation converter did to maths that was already valid

Every maths field is recorded twice: as the model wrote it, and as
`MathNotation` rewrote it for display. This counts the strings KaTeX
accepted before the rewrite and rejected after it. Three shipped bugs
-- `\sqrt16`, `\sine`, `\intx` -- would all have appeared here on
the run that introduced them.

| backend | fields converted | made unrenderable |
|---|---|---|
| `macos-vision + apple-on-device` | 4 | 0 |
